summary: Collins stated in September 2026 that his faith compels him to support Israel and rebuked Ossoff for voting against weapons sales to Israel. Vote for Peace rated him Opposed in the general election. He voted Nay on H.R. 6090, the Antisemitism Awareness Act, in May 2024, but that education vote does not offset his explicit defense of Israel. His platform commits to an America First foreign-policy agenda and backing Trump's legislative priorities, without addressing Gaza or Palestinian rights.
